_meta.description: Demo knowledge base of BIS services for BIS Sahayak AI prototype.
_meta.disclaimer: This is synthetic demo data created for hackathon prototyping. Service descriptions, process steps, and document lists are illustrative. Always verify authoritative requirements at https://www.bis.gov.in or the relevant BIS regional office before initiating any application.

services.name: BIS Product Certification — Scheme I (ISI Mark)
services.description: The primary product certification scheme administered by BIS under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986. Grants license to use the ISI mark on products that conform to relevant Indian Standards. Covers both domestic and foreign manufacturers.
services.target_user: Indian manufacturers, foreign manufacturers (via FMCS), and their authorised agents seeking BIS certification for products covered under compulsory certification.
process_steps: Submit application to the relevant BIS Branch Office
BIS reviews documentation and conducts preliminary assessment
Factory inspection by BIS officers
Product samples drawn and tested at BIS-recognised lab
Evaluation of test results against applicable Indian Standard
Grant of license if all requirements are met
Surveillance audits and renewal as per BIS schedule

services.name: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
services.description: Government-mandated registration scheme for specified electronics and IT products. Manufacturers must register their products with BIS before selling in India. Notified under the Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order.
services.target_user: Manufacturers and importers of electronics and IT products (LEDs, mobile phones, tablets, laptops, power adapters, etc.) sold in India.
required_documents: Online CRS application via BIS portal
Authorised Indian Representative (AIR) details (for foreign manufacturers)
process_steps: Obtain test report from BIS-recognised lab
Register on BIS online portal and fill CRS application
Upload test reports and required documents
Pay prescribed application and registration fees
BIS reviews application and grants registration
Affix standard mark (IS logo + R-number) on product

services.name: Hallmarking of Gold and Silver Articles
services.description: BIS hallmarking scheme ensures the purity of gold and silver articles. BIS-recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centres test and hallmark articles. Includes three marks: BIS logo, purity grade, and hallmarking centre's identification mark.
services.target_user: Jewellers, goldsmiths, and consumers seeking assurance of precious metal purity.
required_documents: Details of articles to be hallmarked
process_steps: Jeweller registers with BIS for hallmarking
Articles submitted to nearest BIS-recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centre
Centre tests the precious metal content using XRF or fire assay methods
If purity meets standard, hallmark is affixed
Hallmarked article returned to jeweller
Consumer can verify hallmark via BIS Care app

services.name: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)
services.description: Enables foreign manufacturers to obtain BIS certification for their products without establishing a physical presence in India. BIS conducts factory inspections abroad.
services.target_user: Manufacturers located outside India who wish to export and sell certified products in the Indian market.
process_steps: Appoint an Authorised Indian Representative (AIR)
Submit FMCS application to BIS headquarters
BIS reviews documentation and schedules foreign factory audit
BIS officers conduct on-site factory inspection
Product samples tested at BIS-recognised laboratory
License granted if requirements are satisfied
Periodic surveillance and renewal

services.name: Laboratory Recognition Scheme
services.description: BIS recognises testing laboratories that meet specified competence criteria. Recognised laboratories conduct product testing for BIS certification purposes.
services.target_user: Testing laboratories seeking BIS recognition; manufacturers needing test reports from recognised labs.
process_steps: Laboratory submits application with supporting documents
BIS reviews documentation and assesses scope
On-site assessment of laboratory capabilities
Proficiency testing or inter-laboratory comparison (if required)
Grant of recognition if criteria are met
Annual surveillance and renewal

services.name: Standardization — Technical Committee Participation
services.description: BIS operates Sectoral Councils and Technical Committees for the development of Indian Standards. Stakeholders can participate in the standard-setting process.
services.target_user: Industry professionals, academicians, government representatives, and consumer organisations interested in contributing to Indian Standards development.
process_steps: Submit expression of interest to the relevant BIS division
BIS evaluates expertise and nominates member
Member participates in Technical Committee meetings
Draft Indian Standard circulated for public review
Comments incorporated and standard finalised
Standard published by BIS

services.name: BIS Care App — Verification Services
services.description: BIS Care mobile application allows consumers and businesses to verify the authenticity of BIS hallmarked jewellery, certified products, and check the validity of BIS licenses.
services.target_user: Consumers, jewellers, retailers, and enforcement officers.
required_documents: BIS Care app (available on Google Play Store and Apple App Store)
Hallmark number or license number for verification
process_steps: Download and install BIS Care app
Select the verification service (hallmark / license / CRS)
Enter the relevant number or scan the QR code
App displays verification result and product details

services.name: BIS Logo and Standard Mark Usage License
services.description: Licence to use the BIS standard mark (ISI mark, CRS mark, or hallmark) on certified products. The mark signifies conformity to the relevant Indian Standard and BIS certification.
required_documents: Mark usage application (if applying for first time)
process_steps: Obtain valid BIS product certification license
Apply for standard mark usage rights
Receive mark specifications and guidelines from BIS
Affix mark on product per BIS marking guidelines
Mark usage is subject to periodic BIS audit

services.name: BIS Conformity Assessment — Education Products
services.description: BIS certification scheme for educational products and materials as per relevant Indian Standards. Ensures quality and safety of educational items.
services.target_user: Manufacturers of educational kits, laboratory equipment, stationery, and related products.
process_steps: Identify applicable Indian Standard for the educational product
Submit application and test reports to BIS
BIS evaluates documentation and conducts factory inspection
Samples tested for conformity
Certification granted upon successful evaluation

services.name: BIS Complaint and Grievance Redressal
services.description: Mechanism for consumers and stakeholders to lodge complaints regarding misuse of BIS marks, non-conforming products, or issues with BIS services.
services.target_user: Consumers, industry stakeholders, and enforcement agencies.
process_steps: Lodge complaint via BIS website, app, or regional office
BIS registers the complaint and assigns reference number
Preliminary investigation by BIS enforcement team
Field inspection and product sampling (if required)
Action taken and complainant informed of outcome
